- `/design-tools:ui-craft` — The ui-craft base: discovery, anti-slop rules, knobs and Craft Report; actions build | animate | review | polish | audit. (writes)

- `/design-tools:ui-craft-tokens` — Establishes or audits the three-layer design-token spine (primitive → semantic → component). (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-shape` — Wireframes one new section into .ui-craft/spec.md — layout, state lattice, acceptance bar; writes a spec, not code. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-craft` — Builds a surface from the spec with ui-craft recipes (dashboard, landing, auth). (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-sddesign` — ui-craft's six-gate conveyor for one surface: brief → tokens → shape → craft → converge → ship. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-finalize` — Ship gate: READY / NOT READY / BLOCKED with findings; never edits. (read-only)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-remember` — Appends a learned design constraint to .ui-craft/brief.md §6 so future sessions obey it. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-polish` — Final finish pass on a surface that is already right: alignment, spacing, micro-details, using project tokens. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-typeset` — Retunes the typography of existing UI: modular scale, tracking, leading, weight hierarchy, micro-typography. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-colorize` — Applies and tunes colour on existing UI: palette use, theming, dark mode, accent budget. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-adapt` — Makes an existing layout responsive: breakpoints, touch targets, safe areas, fluid type, container queries. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-distill` — Removes noise from an over-built surface: cuts sections, elements and decoration that earn nothing. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-bolder` — Amplifies personality inside the current direction: stronger type, contrast, signature details. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-quieter` — Tones a loud surface down: fewer accents, calmer type and motion, more whitespace. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-extract` — Pulls repeated markup into reusable components and tokens. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-redesign` — ui-craft's redesign lens: re-composes an existing surface against the brief and tokens. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-delight` — Adds purposeful micro-interactions — hover, press, success moments — within the motion tokens. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-animate` — Adds or adjusts animation inside the project's motion token system (durations, easings, intensity). (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-unhappy` — Designs the non-happy states first — empty, loading, error, partial — and turns boolean soup into a state machine. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-harden` — Production-hardens a surface: skeletons, empty/error/partial states, i18n, offline, permissions, first run. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-clarify` — Rewrites UX copy: error messages, empty states, CTAs, voice matrix, reading level. (writes)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-audit` — Technical accessibility audit inside a build session: contrast, focus, ARIA, keyboard; report only. (read-only)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-critique` — UX critique of a surface — what to change and why; no code changes. (read-only)
- `/design-tools:ui-craft-heuristic` — Scores a surface 0–100 against heuristics and personas; PM-ready audit, read-only. (read-only)
